method: mcp fetch service, rendered text extraction; no competitor inputs submitted
source_scope: Detail-page controls and explanatory text only; not runtime parity or copied implementation

observations.observed: Numeric and expression templates; examples include numberStep, random Unicode, random alphabets, 2–36 radix and arbitrary integer stepping.
observations.delivery_boundary: Exact finite-decimal arithmetic with literal affixes and separators covers a useful subset; expressions, random template functions and nondecimal sequence rendering stay open.

observations.observed: Separate Chinese-character, word, letter and digit tables. Automatic/manual calculation and output count controls.
observations.excerpt: 汉字频率 = 汉字出现次数 / 总字符数；单词频率 = 单词出现次数 / (汉字数量 + 单词数量 + 数字数量)；字母频率 = 字母出现次数 / 总字符数；数字频率 = 数字出现次数 / (汉字数量 + 单词数量 + 数字数量)。
observations.delivery_boundary: Generic codepoint table has an explicit kept-transformed-codepoint denominator; it does not reproduce all four categorized tables or peer word/digit denominators. Retain partial.

observations.observed: Character-set selector and explicit LF/CRLF normalization in addition to encode/decode.
observations.excerpt: 字符集：将使用选择的字符集，将输入的字符串转换为字节数组，然后将字节数组转换为Base32字符串。
observations.delivery_boundary: The byte workflow supports UTF-8 and exact original line endings; other character sets and explicit LF/CRLF normalization remain open. Retain partial.
